name: Open World
description: A seamless streamed world where discovery is the progression: POIs reveal themselves, encounters spawn at your level just out of sight, and the world keeps your changes. Sandbox RPG folds into this pack — world_state_flags and the POI network are what make roaming feel authored.
loop: roam → discover POI → engage content on your terms → world reacts

signatureCompound.name: Roam and React
signatureCompound.description: streaming_world_loader pages the world and its entities seamlessly as the player roams, point_of_interest_network turns geography into discovered content, dynamic_encounter_spawner populates it at the right level, and world_state_flags makes what the player did there permanent. The loop is the map filling in.
